cohort: 806 mother-infant pairs within 24 hours of birth at Juba Teaching Hospital in 2017
finding: More than half of the mothers delayed the initiation of breastfeeding, with cesarean section, discarding colostrum, unmarried status, exposure to formula ads, and lack of homeownership being associated with delay.
mod_finding: Birth by Cesarean section was significantly associated with delayed initiation of breastfeeding (AOR 41; 95% CI 12.21, 138).
